text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's afternoon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian Parliament chairman Vytautas Landsbergis said he hopes that President Algirdas Brazauskas will not play unclear games and will sign the law on property restitution.

- Government and non-government organisations must do more to help children resist sexual abuse. This was the message delivered at the beginning of a conference organised by children's rights group Children's Rescue.
- The case of Igor Tiomkin, one of the former alleged leaders of the notorius "Vilnius Brigade" organised crime group, is expected to be passed to court this week.
